name: Japanese Milk Bread
directions: Combine Tangzhong ingredients into a small saucepan and whisk until no lumps remain
Place saucepan over low heat and whisking constantly until thick (it should be sticky). Should take about 3-5 minutes
Transfer Tangzhong into a small cup until lukewarm
Combine flour, sugar, salt, yeast, milk, egg, butter, and Tangzhong until a dough forms. Then, knead the dough until smooth.
Shape dough into a ball and cover for 1 to 1.5 hours
Deflate the dough and divide into four equal pieces.
roll dough into a log about 8 inches and roll into 4 inch logs and tuck pieces at the bottom
Place four rolls into a lightly buttered 9x5 in loaf pan
Cover pan and let rest for 40-50 minutes
Preheat oven to 350° F and brush dough with some milk on top
Bake for about 30-35 minutes until golden brown.
Let dough cool completely and serve.
